subject: Re: Mesh Diffusion kickoff — status + preprocessing bottleneck
body:
Status:

- End-to-end sampling worked on 04-08: FLVAE + FLDM checkpoint dirs wired per the released config (trainer_checkpoint_dir / model_checkpoint_dir), labels read from the ply file, textures land in the output dir. Linnea's samples on the demo meshes look genuinely production-quality.
- The catch: preprocessing. Artist meshes are messier than the curated ones — non-manifold edges and degenerate triangles break the field-latent preprocessing step on 2 of the first 6 meshes we tried. Maren has a repair pass (remeshing + label reprojection) that fixes one; the other needs manual cleanup, which artists won't tolerate at scale.

Risk for the 06-08 pilot: we can hit it if we pre-screen meshes and are upfront that ~1 in 5 needs manual prep. Longer-term fix is a robust remesher, which is real engineering — proposing it as the Q3 follow-on rather than cramming it in.

Also: single-mesh training means each new mesh family wants its own FLDM — worth setting artist expectations now.

Hyun
